description: Scripture with conventional and psychological readings: expect interpretation-basis concepts, none of them central.
quoteText: Except a man be born again, he cannot see the kingdom of God.

interpretations.interpretation: Being born again is a spiritual rebirth into Christian faith, which the saying makes necessary for perceiving or entering the kingdom of God.
A person must become aware of the biases and habits through which they see the world before they can perceive what that way of seeing hides.
